授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This is an introductory course in economic principles and global economic issues. We will explore fundamental human and social questions such as how people decide to allocate their scarce resources (e.g., time, money, attention, energy), how people interact to satisfy their needs, and how an economy works as a whole. Through the lens of basic economic models and empirical evidence, we will analyze the power of incentives, the virtues and limitations of markets, and the sources of human prosperity.
The course is divided into microeconomics and macroeconomics. Microeconomic analysis focuses on how  consumers and producers  make decisions and interact in the marketplace. Further topics to be discussed include the role of government, market failures, and game theory. Macroeconomic analysis focuses on how an economy works as a whole. Key topics to be discussed include basic concepts of macroeconomics, full-employment macroeconomics, and macroeconomics fluctuations.
